section_5_motif_continuity_law.purpose: Allow motifs to reappear across scenes to strengthen emotional memory.
rules: Motifs may persist as recurring visual anchors within an episode.
The same motif may reappear in different time states if continuity_capable is true.
Motif reappearance should support emotional memory, not create symbol clutter.
Scenario field carries motif presence through location, atmosphere, and visible environment.
Character field must not narrate motif meaning — visual presence only.

examples.effect: same window strengthens domestic emotional memory

section_6_motif_density_law.protagonist_readability_rule: Motifs support atmosphere; they must not compete with Gonegi or primary action.

grammar_alignment.field_separation: Motifs appear in scenario field context; character field remains visual identity only
grammar_alignment.persistent_object_rule: toast and carried objects follow continuity_state_law
